canonical_case.title: Artifact download按user/registration token/Agent credential的实际允许路径验证

goal: 核对现存Artifact的用户会话、注册码和已owned Native4 Agent凭证下载矩阵；只读下载并校验真实bytes/SHA/size，不写Artifact、Node、文件、Host或配置。

target_artifact.selection: 执行时先Admin GET /api/artifacts确认当前集合恰有一个；从实时只读列表取ID/size/sha256，只留安全白名单元数据。任何0或多于1、或GET/metadata状态异常则停给Root裁定。
target_artifact.do_not_reuse_deleted_artifact_id: a64190ec-92a4-4407-b8c3-a0adcbee1d56 was deleted and its GET verified 404 in qa-resume-20261010-host-tls/cleanup-artifact-delete.json.
target_artifact.body_handling: 成功下载仅流式计算byte count与SHA-256；不写本地文件、不输出或保存artifact contents。

observed_auth_contract.user: Authorization: Bearer <valid read-capable user session> is tried first.
observed_auth_contract.registration_token: Actual implementation accepts X-NodeSteer-Agent-Token or query agent_token. Use header only; never put token in URL. This token alone is global registration token and does not require Agent ID.
observed_auth_contract.node_credential: Requires both X-NodeSteer-Agent-ID and X-NodeSteer-Agent-Token; ID resolves existing Node and AuthenticateAgent checks stored credential.
observed_auth_contract.source_observation: Comment mentions Authorization carrying registration token, but actual handler only falls back to X-NodeSteer-Agent-Token/query; do not infer or test unsupported Authorization format as an allowed path.
